title: A high-density non-equiatomic WTaMoNbV high-entropy alloy: Alloying behavior, microstructure and mechanical properties
process_description: prepared by mechanical alloying of high-purity W, Ta, Mo, Nb and V powders (99.9 wt%) in stainless-steel vials with tungsten carbide balls at a ball-to-powder ratio of 10:1 using a planetary ball mill at 300 rpm for 55 h, followed by spark plasma sintering at 1600-1800°C for 1-10 min under 30 MPa axial pressure in vacuum.
